notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33443854/7b187cfb62d5481b07093f10a8abb82a0b6e1aad.jpg

人物说明——未知（右）

在爱亚利亚晶体降临幻想乡之后，有一些不可名状的物体也随之出现了。大多数目击者都很难准确描述出它们的形态，或者干脆说它们类似于一个个问号一样躺在路中间。这些东西，我们称之为“拟态”，一直在学习它们在地产竞赛中见到的简单行为——从路过的人手里拿走钱，晶体。或者更加复杂的行为，比如把人传送到其他地方。而最为特别的一个存在已经进化出了人形，有人说像是穿着蓝色巫女服的灵梦，而这个个体的行为更加高级——她会控制所有其他的拟态，甚至通过同化，让所有的敌人都暂时归在她的控制之下。来到东方大战争的她，会不会将一切弄得一团糟呢？

人物说明——火之高兴（左）

这是幻想乡居民目击的第二个高级爱亚利亚拟态生物，与其他拟态不同，这个拟态倾向于单独行动，而且其并不会模仿一个特定的行为。实际上，我是指它的基本特性，所作所为都和我们所熟知的模式完全相反——它不按照现有的规则办事，会神不知鬼不觉的获得金钱、晶体、卡片，甚至是房地产。而且其外貌也随着进化而变得清晰——像极了那位日阴的魔女，但她和阴郁毫不沾边，实际上，这是一个充满了火热情怀的阳光女孩——物理意义上。同时，可能是由于不按规则出牌，这种个体极不稳定，会有一定的概率什么都不做，或者在结算时给错钱。携带着太阳力量的她这次穿越到东方大战争的世界里，一定会掀起一场新的波澜吧。

可透露的信息

大战争这里也有两位穿越者跑去异文石世界了哦~擅长战斗的他们在争夺地盘与金钱的游戏中又能发挥出什么样的力量呢？

notes.title: Store Update Compensation and Future Plans
notes.content:
Sorry for my poor English, hope some one can help correct my grammar mistake.

We made a very big change on THBBB store system, now we will able to make more characters and more skins easily without add too many DLCs. 
We have asked and listened to players from many communities about this update, most players are happy and support our change. Thanks for your support.

But some players, especially those not in Chinese community, or those haven't play THBBB for a long time, may feel not comfortable with this change. Some are because they don't fully understand what we will do, so we would like to explain about it here again.

Step1: in the previous updates
-Player's minions and minions' level has been return to equivalent coins. 
-Old coins has been change to new coins, with some extra reward.
3 old coin equals 1 new coin. 
-Minions' level was deleted.

Step2: will happen in 2 weeks
-DLC character pack will be removed from Steam store.
-Players bought DLCs will get all DLC characters directly in the new Store.
-Players bought DLCs will get 360 stars, equals 150% of DLC price.

Step3：will happen on late December or early January
-THBBB will become free! hope this will get more new players.
--Players already bought THBBB will get 900 stars, equals 250% of game price

About skin DLCs
-DLC skin pack will be removed from steam store.
-People with DLC Skins will get all DLC Skins directly in the new Store.
-DLC skin can be bought in new store with same price.

================================================
We are very sorry about the bad experience. We didn't explained every thing very well, it finally leads to a lot of bad review on Steam. We hope people understand that this game is still in EarlyAccess, we will change the game a lot. There are also a lot of historical problem. Bug and Economy system problem seems inevitable. We have to make every thing correct.

In the previous version, we didn't make that “Draw Character” system very seriously because of Early Access. All characters were almost free to obtain. After recent update, some player now feel that they no longer have all characters, so they feel very sad. But actually in LOL, Heroes of the Storm or many other famous MOBA game, most players with 500 hours will not able to have all characters. It's very hard for the developer of a MOBA game to survive without doing this change in current situation. We hope people can understand.

We really want make THBBB a good game, we fully understand some Steam Player don't like In-Game-Store, but this is our best choice for this kind of game now. Even many huge company have to do this to survive. We are only a small team, we spent more on THBBB than we earned yet, we are under pressure from many aspect. We will not abandon THBBB, we want continue making it better. We hope people can support us.

As a small team, we can't do perfect on every aspect like other big experienced company does, we don't even have a good translator for this article. We hope some angry players can be more patient, and accept our new Store, it's not that bad right?

We feel really thankful for all your support!

Now, we are working on
-Shanghai WePlay Game Show, THBBB game contest. (12.7-12.8)
-Adventure mode will be online after WePlay.
-More graphics, effects rework.
-Experimental Secret Big Big Update in the future. 

Have a nice game!

MyACG Studio

notes.title: 11月19日，gameversion update
notes.content:
Others。
Fixed the problem that OBS could not get the data for the window resolution , should make streaming a lot more better

Basic rule

Number of cards allowed per match
12→9

Still fixing the UI, currently just put 3 locked card slots at the Deck part
Reason for the fix:
We hope to provide the players with a different type of experience each time
Despite the fact that players can get 7 types of minions on paper, during actual battle, they would more or less get only 4 to 5
If players are allowed to bring 12 cards, it would be kind of one sided during battles, characters with weakness/strength will stands out, a lot, and resulting in a way-to-linear game play per match.
As such ,we hope to add this feature so that players will be more mindful about their decks, to bring out a more or less balanced deck with minions that are all-round . 
 

Data
Changed the HP and damage values of all the units
Everyone have a buff in HP
Reasons for it:
In previous ver , the skills’ damage are too OP-ish, as the second the battle starts , the players will start to nuke the crap out of each other, and the match will be over, in the blind of an eye,which is very not newbie friendly. 
We hope this ver could at least stretch each wave’s duration, to allow the commanders to have a better overview on the battle

notes.content:
优化	
继续优化战斗模块，
重点是现在人机因为用了一些奇怪的写法导致很多人的人机比匹配卡的问题

 BUG	
优先解决战斗UI重做导致的各种问题
比如技能圈连按的话会永远不消掉的问题

 2v2模式	
会更认真一点的完善2v2模式的竞技性。
对这个模式做更多的数值上的调整。
解决一下遗留bug比如决战刷兵数不对。

可以组队进入2v2。

 卡组养成	
为了更好的让玩家有一个公平对战的环境。
有可能放弃兵种卡会随着等级一直有数值成长的设定。
作为补偿，随着卡片升级，可以获得很多跟这个角色相关的收集元素。
比如玩家头像，游戏中的动态表情，游戏里角色可以说的话，等等。
也可能会有短暂的数值成长，比如1-3级数值会变高，但是后边就固定了。

 服务器	
最晚下周末先赔本组个美服吧，海外玩家应该可以玩了
好穷啊

 多语言	
一个大概能用的日语版
一个大概能用的韩语版
话说你们需要繁体中文吗？可以顺手做了…

 平衡性	
一直更，慢慢调

可能会重做魔理沙兵种
可能会减少1v1模式的战斗波数
可能会加一下主画面音效。

可能会改善对面强退以后剩下的玩家的体验，比如更快的判他赢

因为有大量玩家反馈，一致认为尽管在游戏没有内置收费抽卡的情况下，只要游戏本体是免费的，这个游戏一定就是在骗氪、逼氪、变着法让人氪。

所以我们决定移除本体免费策略。
对能接受或者说看好现在的形式的玩家表示抱歉。

应该会改回游戏卖36，带所有现在有的卡组，现在在跟steam申请改价中，可能需要一个很麻烦的过程，应该能保证现在买过36的人可以直接获取游戏。也应该能没买过36初始包的玩家可以保留账号，卡组。如果确定了会另行通知改动时间和方式等等。应该不会在下周能完成，只是开始做。

如果STEAM审核够快的话就会发
